title: Clone Linked List with Next and Random Pointer
problemStatement: A singly linked list contains two pointers: next random The random pointer may point to any node in the list or be null. Create a deep copy of the linked list and return the head of the copied list.
input: A linked list with next and random pointers.
output: The head of the cloned linked list.
constraints: Number of nodes is in the range [0, 1000]
